audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for specific guilt cases, sliding-scale offering access, confession, birds/flour options, holy-things misuse, and asham/guilt offering.

verses.restored: When a soul/life sins/misaligns, hearing voice of oath as witness, whether he saw or knew, if he does not tell, he shall bear his iniquity.

familiar.text: And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, whether he hath seen or known of it; if he do not utter it, then he shall bear his iniquity.

modern.text: “If someone sins by failing to testify when he hears a public charge about something he has witnessed, whether he has seen it or learned of it, he shall bear the iniquity.

original.text: וְנֶ֣פֶשׁ כִּֽי תֶחֱטָ֗א וְשָֽׁמְעָה֙ ק֣וֹל אָלָ֔ה וְה֣וּא עֵ֔ד א֥וֹ רָאָ֖ה א֣וֹ יָדָ֑ע אִם ל֥וֹא יַגִּ֖יד וְנָשָׂ֥א עֲוֺנֽוֹ

verses.restored: Or when a soul/life touches any unclean thing, whether carcass of unclean wild animal, unclean domestic animal, or unclean swarming thing, and it is hidden from him, and he is unclean and guilty,

familiar.text: Or if a soul touch any unclean thing, whether it be a carcase of an unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean creeping things, and if it be hidden from him; he also shall be unclean, and guilty.

modern.text: Or if a person touches anything unclean—whether the carcass of any unclean wild animal or livestock or crawling creature—even if he is unaware of it, he is unclean and guilty.

original.text: א֣וֹ נֶ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּגַּע֮ בְּכָל דָּבָ֣ר טָמֵא֒ אוֹ֩ בְנִבְלַ֨ת חַיָּ֜ה טְמֵאָ֗ה א֤וֹ בְּנִבְלַת֙ בְּהֵמָ֣ה טְמֵאָ֔ה א֕וֹ בְּנִבְלַ֖ת שֶׁ֣רֶץ טָמֵ֑א וְנֶעְלַ֣ם מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וְה֥וּא טָמֵ֖א וְאָשֵֽׁם

verses.restored: or when he touches human uncleanness, any uncleanness by which one becomes unclean, and it is hidden from him, then he knows and becomes guilty,

familiar.text: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness it be that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty.

modern.text: Or if he touches human uncleanness—anything by which one becomes unclean—even if he is unaware of it, when he realizes it, he is guilty.

original.text: א֣וֹ כִ֤י יִגַּע֙ בְּטֻמְאַ֣ת אָדָ֔ם לְכֹל֙ טֻמְאָת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִטְמָ֖א בָּ֑הּ וְנֶעְלַ֣ם מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וְה֥וּא יָדַ֖ע וְאָשֵֽׁם

verses.restored: or when a soul/life swears rashly with lips to do evil or to do good, whatever a human utters rashly with oath, and it is hidden from him, then he knows and becomes guilty in one of these,

familiar.text: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty in one of these.

modern.text: Or if someone swears thoughtlessly with his lips to do anything good or evil—in whatever matter a man may rashly pronounce an oath—even if he is unaware of it, when he realizes it, he is guilty in the matter.

original.text: א֣וֹ נֶ֡פֶשׁ כִּ֣י תִשָּׁבַע֩ לְבַטֵּ֨א בִשְׂפָתַ֜יִם לְהָרַ֣ע א֣וֹ לְהֵיטִ֗יב לְ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְבַטֵּ֧א הָאָדָ֛ם בִּשְׁבֻעָ֖ה וְנֶעְלַ֣ם מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְהוּא יָדַ֥ע וְאָשֵׁ֖ם לְאַחַ֥ת מֵאֵֽלֶּה

verses.restored: it shall be when he becomes guilty in one of these, he shall confess what he sinned/misaligned concerning it.

familiar.text: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these things, that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that thing:

modern.text: If someone incurs guilt in one of these ways, he must confess the sin he has committed,

original.text: וְהָיָ֥ה כִֽי יֶאְשַׁ֖ם לְאַחַ֣ת מֵאֵ֑לֶּה וְהִ֨תְוַדָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖א עָלֶֽיהָ

verses.restored: He shall bring his guilt/reparation to YHWH for his sin/misalignment that he sinned: a female from flock, lamb or goat, for sin/misalignment offering, and priest shall make atonement/covering for him from his sin/misalignment.

familiar.text: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin.

modern.text: and he must bring his guilt offering to the LORD for the sin he has committed: a female lamb or goat from the flock as a sin offering. And the priest will make atonement for him concerning his sin.

original.text: וְהֵבִ֣יא אֶת אֲשָׁמ֣וֹ לַיהוָ֡ה עַ֣ל חַטָּאתוֹ֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָטָ֜א נְקֵבָ֨ה מִן הַצֹּ֥אן כִּשְׂבָּ֛ה אֽוֹ שְׂעִירַ֥ת עִזִּ֖ים לְחַטָּ֑את וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛יו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן מֵחַטָּאתֽוֹ

verses.restored: If his hand does not reach enough for sheep/goat, he shall bring as his guilt/reparation for what he sinned two turtledoves or two sons of pigeon to YHWH, one for sin/misalignment offering and one for burnt offering.

familiar.text: And if he be not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass, which he hath committed, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, unto the LORD; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

modern.text: If, however, he cannot afford a lamb, he may bring to the LORD as restitution for his sin two turtledoves or two young pigeons—one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering.

original.text: וְאִם לֹ֨א תַגִּ֣יע יָדוֹ֮ דֵּ֣י שֶׂה֒ וְהֵבִ֨יא אֶת אֲשָׁמ֜וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֗א שְׁתֵּ֥י תֹרִ֛ים אֽוֹ שְׁנֵ֥י בְנֵֽי יוֹנָ֖ה לַֽיהוָ֑ה אֶחָ֥ד לְחַטָּ֖את וְאֶחָ֥ד לְעֹלָֽה

verses.restored: He shall bring them to priest, and priest shall bring near first that which is for sin/misalignment offering, pinch its head at back of neck but not divide it.

familiar.text: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first, and wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide it asunder:

modern.text: He is to bring them to the priest, who shall first present the one for the sin offering. He is to twist its head at the front of its neck without severing it;

original.text: וְהֵבִ֤יא אֹתָם֙ אֶל הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִקְרִ֛יב אֶת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַחַטָּ֖את רִאשׁוֹנָ֑ה וּמָלַ֧ק אֶת רֹאשׁ֛וֹ מִמּ֥וּל עָרְפּ֖וֹ וְלֹ֥א יַבְדִּֽיל

verses.restored: He shall sprinkle from blood/life of sin/misalignment offering on side of altar, and remaining blood/life shall be drained at base of altar; it is sin/misalignment offering.

familiar.text: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it is a sin offering.

modern.text: then he is to sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar, while the rest of the blood is drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

original.text: וְהִזָּ֞ה מִדַּ֤ם הַחַטָּאת֙ עַל קִ֣יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְהַנִּשְׁאָ֣ר בַּדָּ֔ם יִמָּצֵ֖ה אֶל יְס֣וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ חַטָּ֖את הֽוּא

verses.restored: The second he shall make burnt offering according to judgment. Priest shall make atonement/covering for him from his sin/misalignment that he sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.

familiar.text: And he shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the manner: and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he hath sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.

modern.text: And the priest must prepare the second bird as a burnt offering according to the ordinance. In this way the priest will make atonement for him for the sin he has committed, and he will be forgiven.

original.text: וְאֶת הַשֵּׁנִ֛י יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה עֹלָ֖ה כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן מֵחַטָּאת֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָ֖א וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ

verses.restored: If his hand does not reach two turtledoves or two sons of pigeon, then he shall bring as his offering for what he sinned a tenth ephah of fine flour for sin/misalignment offering; he shall not put oil on it nor give frankincense on it, for it is sin/misalignment offering.

familiar.text: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon: for it is a sin offering.

modern.text: But if he cannot afford two turtledoves or two young pigeons, he may bring a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a sin offering. He must not put olive oil or frankincense on it, because it is a sin offering.

original.text: וְאִם לֹא֩ תַשִּׂ֨יג יָד֜וֹ לִשְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֗ים אוֹ֮ לִשְׁנֵ֣י בְנֵי יוֹנָה֒ וְהֵבִ֨יא אֶת קָרְבָּנ֜וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֗א עֲשִׂירִ֧ת הָאֵפָ֛ה סֹ֖לֶת לְחַטָּ֑את לֹא יָשִׂ֨ים עָלֶ֜יהָ שֶׁ֗מֶן וְלֹא יִתֵּ֤ן עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ לְבֹנָ֔ה כִּ֥י חַטָּ֖את הִֽיא

verses.restored: He shall bring it to priest, and priest shall grasp from it full handful as memorial portion and turn it into smoke on altar upon fire-offerings of YHWH; it is sin/misalignment offering.

familiar.text: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, even a memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: it is a sin offering.

modern.text: He is to bring it to the priest, who shall take a handful from it as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar atop the offerings made by fire to the LORD; it is a sin offering.

original.text: וֶהֱבִיאָהּ֮ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן֒ וְקָמַ֣ץ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן מִ֠מֶּנָּה מְל֨וֹא קֻמְצ֜וֹ אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָה֙ וְהִקְטִ֣יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עַ֖ל אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהוָ֑ה חַטָּ֖את הִֽוא

verses.restored: Priest shall make atonement/covering for him over his sin/misalignment that he sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him; it shall belong to priest like grain offering.

familiar.text: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and the remnant shall be the priest’s, as a meat offering.

modern.text: In this way the priest will make atonement for him for any of these sins he has committed, and he will be forgiven. The remainder will belong to the priest, like the grain offering.” Laws for Guilt Offerings (Leviticus 6:1–7; Leviticus 7:1–10)

original.text: וְכִפֶּר֩ עָלָ֨יו הַכֹּהֵ֜ן עַל חַטָּאת֧וֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָ֛א מֵֽאַחַ֥ת מֵאֵ֖לֶּה וְנִסְלַ֣ח ל֑וֹ וְהָיְתָ֥ה לַכֹּהֵ֖ן כַּמִּנְחָֽה

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

verses.restored: When a soul/life acts unfaithfully and sins/misaligns in error/unintentionally regarding holy things of YHWH, he shall bring his guilt/reparation to YHWH: a complete ram from flock, by your valuation in silver shekels according to sanctuary shekel, for guilt offering.

familiar.text: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the LORD; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the LORD a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering:

modern.text: “If someone acts unfaithfully and sins unintentionally against any of the LORD’s holy things, he must bring his guilt offering to the LORD: an unblemished ram from the flock, of proper value in silver shekels according to the sanctuary shekel; it is a guilt offering.

original.text: נֶ֚פֶשׁ כִּֽי תִמְעֹ֣ל מַ֔עַל וְחָֽטְאָה֙ בִּשְׁגָגָ֔ה מִקָּדְשֵׁ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וְהֵבִיא֩ אֶת אֲשָׁמ֨וֹ לַֽיהוָ֜ה אַ֧יִל תָּמִ֣ים מִן הַצֹּ֗אן בְּעֶרְכְּךָ֛ כֶּֽסֶף שְׁקָלִ֥ים בְּשֶֽׁקֶל הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ לְאָשָֽׁם

verses.restored: What he sinned/misaligned from holy thing he shall repay, and add fifth to it, and give it to priest. Priest shall make atonement/covering for him with ram of guilt offering, and it shall be forgiven him.

familiar.text: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.

modern.text: Regarding any holy thing he has harmed, he must make restitution by adding a fifth of its value to it and giving it to the priest, who will make atonement on his behalf with the ram as a guilt offering, and he will be forgiven.

original.text: וְאֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר֩ חָטָ֨א מִן הַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ יְשַׁלֵּ֗ם וְאֶת חֲמִֽישִׁתוֹ֙ יוֹסֵ֣ף עָלָ֔יו וְנָתַ֥ן אֹת֖וֹ לַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְהַכֹּהֵ֗ן יְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָ֛יו בְּאֵ֥יל הָאָשָׁ֖ם וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ

verses.restored: If a soul/life sins/misaligns and does one from any commands of YHWH that should not be done, though he did not know, he is guilty and shall bear his iniquity.

familiar.text: And if a soul sin, and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the LORD; though he wist it not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

modern.text: If someone sins and violates any of the LORD’s commandments even though he was unaware, he is guilty and shall bear his punishment.

original.text: וְאִם נֶ֨פֶשׁ֙ כִּ֣י תֶֽחֱטָ֔א וְעָֽשְׂתָ֗ה אַחַת֙ מִכָּל מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֣א תֵעָשֶׂ֑ינָה וְלֹֽא יָדַ֥ע וְאָשֵׁ֖ם וְנָשָׂ֥א עֲוֺנֽוֹ

verses.restored: He shall bring a complete ram from flock, by your valuation, for guilt offering to priest; priest shall make atonement/covering for him for error that he erred and did not know, and it shall be forgiven him.

familiar.text: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not, and it shall be forgiven him.

modern.text: He is to bring to the priest an unblemished ram of proper value from the flock as a guilt offering. Then the priest will make atonement on his behalf for the wrong he has committed in ignorance, and he will be forgiven.

original.text: וְ֠הֵבִיא אַ֣יִל תָּמִ֧ים מִן הַצֹּ֛אן בְּעֶרְכְּךָ֥ לְאָשָׁ֖ם אֶל הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְכִפֶּר֩ עָלָ֨יו הַכֹּהֵ֜ן עַ֣ל שִׁגְגָת֧וֹ אֲשֶׁר שָׁגָ֛ג וְה֥וּא לֹֽא יָדַ֖ע וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ

verses.restored: It is guilt/reparation offering; guilty, he was guilty before YHWH.

familiar.text: It is a trespass offering: he hath certainly trespassed against the LORD.

modern.text: It is a guilt offering; he was certainly guilty before the LORD.”

translation_notes: Chapter includes confession in v.5: repair includes truthful naming.
Sliding scale access is crucial: flock, birds, or flour; even the poor have a ritual path.
Asham/guilt-reparation offering includes restitution plus added fifth when holy things are misused.
Unclean does not mean morally disgusting; it is ritual-state language requiring careful anti-shame framing.
safety_note: Do not use clean/unclean language for body shame, disability stigma, or disgust toward people. Leviticus 5 offers accessible repair paths and scaled offerings according to means.
